scope: Central decisions on the five membership category holds

decisions.decision: Do not publish from data-centre operations alone
decisions.reason: Ownership and maintenance of local infrastructure do not establish local development of original technology. Globally developed platforms cannot automatically be attributed to the Zurich operational site.
decisions.remaining: Specific local technical-development evidence, not another category decision
decisions.caveat: This is an evidence hold, not a claim that the global companies have no original technology

decisions.decision: Exclude the assessed training-only commercial candidate
decisions.reason: Technical training alone does not satisfy the company-development criterion. Do not label a commercial school a university or nonprofit to bypass it.
decisions.reconsiderWhen: Independent technical development or a separately evidenced qualifying research/community role is established

decisions.decision: Prepare one coherent research-lab identity after fresh deduplication
decisions.reason: The assessed medical-materials/device development is substantive technical research. Do not classify the whole hospital as a university or duplicate overlapping hospital/lab records.
decisions.remaining: Fresh identity and address review, proper name and lab scope, official artwork, verified socials and main publication review
